comment: Only the commands the front end actually calls, and every path-taking one scoped.
The plugins' `default` sets are deliberately not used: `fs:default` carries
`read-app-specific-dirs-recursive`, which would let the webview read the app data
directory, vault.key and every sealed session file included; `opener:default` adds an
unscoped reveal-in-dir; `dialog:default` adds open. The webview is handed the DEK at
boot anyway, so this is depth, not the only thing standing in the way.
The calls, and nothing else: invoke + listen (core), getCurrentWindow().close()
openPath() (components/ConversationExport.tsx). `src/lib.rs` has the test that keeps
this list from drifting back to the default sets.
